newsitem.title: INDIA: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.
newsitem.headline: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.

text.p: THE RALLY MAY FALTER AT 2965-2995 LEVELS ... is a trend
analysis of the 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index for the period December 16 to 20 by analyst Mehmood Khan at Times Guaranty Financials Ltd

Trading for the week ended on a steady note, with a gain of 54.95 points (1.94 percent) at 2881.15 levels over the previous week. The sharp decline in the mean value of the BSE Sensex during Thursday has resulted in the formation of a new pivot resistance at 2965.15. A resistance pivot is a point in price and time where selling pressure overcomes buying demand leading to the formation of a top and subsequent decline in values.

In the present scenario, the formation of the resistance significantly lowers the bullish trigger level. Earlier, the trigger was at 3035.64 and now it is at 2965.15 - resistance pivot level. The trend of the index is currently neutral (sideways). The trend will remain neutral as long as the mean value stays between 2965.15 and 2783.68.

From among the charts scanned after Friday's trading, the technical feature of majority of the pivotals, appears to be best for booking profit in the upsurge at 2970-2990 levels. The interim rally from 2713.12 ran out of steam at 2965.15 as predicted by TGFL last week.

Friday saw the index rise marginally leading to the formation of the support pivot at 2850 for the rally from 2782.03-2965.15. With this, one is probably into the fifth corrective phase 6-7 (3035.64-2713.12) of the ongoing bearishness. The index was resisted at the 80 percent retracement level (3035.64 - 2713.12). The bearish trend which is currently neutral would become bullish above 2965 for the week's trading. On the downside, the bearish trend would be reconfirmed if the index declines below 2770 levels.

The cluster of resistance emerging at the 1x2 Fan lines (63.75 degrees) drawn by taking 2713.12 as the bottom and 2x1 fan lines (26.25 degrees) drawn by 4131.22 as the top. The Sensex has taken support at the 1x1 (45 degrees) trend fan lines from 2713.12 on the daily candle-stick chart.

The price following oscillators on the weekly bar chart are exhibiting that the top has been formed at 2965.15 levels or may be formed marginally higher at 2990 levels - Relative Strength Index (14 RSI) is 33.84, Price Rate of Change (12 ROC) is placed at -13.91, short term stochastic is hovering at 23.26 and its trigger line is at 21.20, while the medium term stochastic is 15.89 and the trigger is 17.83, the Macd is -159.04 with the trigger exhibiting long term bearishness at -119.52, 14 William's percent R positively placed at -78.92 & the Price oscillator is placed at -3.49 justify the above assumption.

For the current week, the BSE Sensex may encounter resistance at 2933-2995 levels, on the lower end it may find support at 2840-2805 levels. The National Index may witness profit booking at 1295-1320 levels and support at 1268 & 1242 levels.
(The opinions expressed in this article reflect the views of the author only. They should not be taken as reflecting the views of Reuters).
